principle: physical reality and authoritative source state are upstream of models; models and interfaces are replaceable capabilities; authority, assurance, custodial constraints and independent safety controls remain explicit.

layers.name: Physical Reality
layers.rule: digital state never substitutes for physical verification

layers.name: Sensing & Actuation
layers.rule: consequential actuation requires scoped authority and independent safe-state path

layers.name: Host / Device / Network
layers.rule: host capability is not semantic authority

layers.name: Source & Evidence Providers
layers.rule: provider location is not authority; revision/hash/provenance required

layers.name: CGX Kernel & Semantic State
layers.rule: one authority per meaning; many representations permitted

layers.name: Epistemic / Evidence Qualification
layers.rule: conceptual/metaphysical models remain labelled unless empirically promoted

layers.name: Assurance
layers.rule: assurance evidence is not execution authority or ethical sovereignty

layers.name: Custodial & Lifecycle Reasoning
layers.rule: moral compass is multi-lens and non-sovereign; preserve dissent

layers.name: Domain Semantics
layers.rule: children retain scoped semantic ownership and bind shared services by reference

layers.name: Agent Runtime
layers.rule: agent identity/role persists independently of model provider; authority is explicit and leased/scoped

layers.name: Model / Reasoning Capabilities
layers.rule: model strength, confidence, majority or persistence never grants authority

layers.name: Tools / Providers / Automation
layers.rule: tools execute bounded capabilities and return receipts; tool output is evidence/proposal until reconciled

layers.name: Workflow / Queue / Resolver Plane
layers.rule: assurance and custodial preflights occur before consequential execution

layers.name: Independent Safety Plane
layers.rule: mission intelligence cannot rewrite, veto or peer-vote around independent safety controls

layers.name: Interaction Surfaces
layers.rule: surface is projection/interaction only; no semantic authority by display

layers.name: Representations & Publication
layers.rule: publication is a derived release-gated representation

layers.name: Continuity / Archive / Inheritance
layers.rule: persistent knowledge is preferred over persistent executable agency when active authority is absent

degraded_modes.behaviour: use eligible local model/classical tools or reduce to deterministic/read-only capability; authority does not expand
use verified cache only within expiry/criticality limits; consequential stale-source work holds
local bounded lease; contract toward safe/stewardship state over time
freeze expansion/novel irreversible commitments; maintain LIFE/SAFETY/ECO/knowledge functions
quarantine model output; deterministic or human/specialist fallback
